articles.summary: Board to recommend that shareholders approve renaming the Company Milk Makeup plc The Company’s Board of Directors has approved the voluntary delisting of the Company’s Class A Ordinary Shares and Warrants from Nasdaq and the deregistration of those securities under the Exchange Act.
articles.title: Waldencast plc Announces Intention to Voluntarily Delist from Nasdaq and Deregister its Securities under the Exchange Act
